memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “Moreover it is required in stewards that one be found faithful.”- 1 Corinthians 4:2

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Many desire to be a VIP in the eyes of people, but in God’s kingdom, true importance is measured by faithfulness. Vision is the starting point,it is seeing God’s purpose clearly before it unfolds. Without vision, people may be busy, but they lack direction. God-given vision aligns our life with His eternal plan.
However, vision must be carried by integrity. Integrity means living the same life before God, in public and in private. David became king not because of his skill, but because he was faithful in small matters and always sought the Lord’s counsel. God trusted David with a lasting throne, and his integrity produced a generational blessing. Jesus Christ was called the Son of David. 

Integrity builds what success alone cannot sustain.
When passion is added to vision and integrity, God releases His mission. Passion is holy fire that moves a believer from burden to prayer, and from prayer to action. Nehemiah’s passion for God’s glory drove him to the Scriptures, fasting, and prayer. That passion opened royal favor and rebuilt broken walls. Vision directs us, integrity grounds us, and passion drives us. This is God’s definition of a true VIP.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God uses the man who is more concerned about holiness than usefulness.”- Watchman Nee

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, give me a clear vision from heaven.
Form in me a heart of integrity that pleases You.
Fill me with holy passion to fulfill Your will.
Make my life trustworthy in Your hands. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: God is not looking for famous people, but for faithful people. If you walk with vision, integrity, and passion, God Himself will call you a VIP.

recommended_book.author: Watchman Nee
recommended_book.quote: This book emphasizes spiritual integrity and obedience rooted in the Cross. It awakens holy passion to live God’s vision through Christ’s life in us.
